WITH grouped_matches AS (
  SELECT 
    r.ordervault,
    o.dealedge,
    COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.dealedge
),
side_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    dealedge,
    SUM(group_count) as side_total
  FROM grouped_matches
  GROUP BY dealedge
)
SELECT 
  gm.ordervault,
  gm.dealedge,
  gm.group_count,
  CAST(gm.group_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(st.side_total AS FLOAT) as quotient
FROM grouped_matches gm
INNER JOIN side_totals st ON gm.dealedge = st.dealedge
ORDER BY quotient DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
